target: Author-converted later fermentation gas volume at native 12/24/36/48 hours
timing_contract: Only native 4/8-hour gas volumes and known trial/algae/horizon; no later volume, end-of-incubation digestibility or GasDM target-derived normalization.
calibration: Trial/algae kinetic and empirical parameters come from development DG1–3; current flask gas at 4/8 h is declared early calibration available to all comparators.
independent_unit: complete DG4 incubation run within each trial; every flask and horizon stay together

empirical_ratio.equation: Ghat(t)=G8*development mean later/8-hour ratio for trial, algae and horizon; frozen fallback for unseen cells.

flexible_fixed.equation: yhat=max(0,intercept+sum_i w_i*exp(-gamma*||encoded_scaled_X-center_i||^2)); all imputation, category encoding, scales and kernel state frozen.

flexible_nested.equation: yhat=max(0,intercept+sum_i w_i*exp(-gamma*||encoded_scaled_X-center_i||^2)); all imputation, category encoding, scales and kernel state frozen.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Show every complete reserved group. Within-system and temporal dependence, few condition blocks or calibrated sites limit population-level claims; no row-bootstrap confidence interval is claimed.

scope_limits: Three reserved incubation runs in three protocols with known algae labels and an 8-hour prefix. No methane-specific prediction, unseen-treatment or in-vivo livestock transfer.

exposure.historical_record: All reference confirmation targets are exposed. This is a retrospective diagnostic evaluation, not fresh independent confirmation.

historical_metric_corrections: F1 uses2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero on nonempty total failure. Historical reports unchanged.
